stage: H1 repeatable sub-700 ms production inference
authority: This machine-readable file is authoritative; docs/PERFORMANCE.md must agree with it.

provenance.threshold_origin: Current user instruction, specified prospectively: <700.000 ms.
provenance.stage_relationship: Post-M5/post-release engineering; historical acceptance records are not reopened or weakened.

primary_latency.start: A complete valid 3-second mono waveform is already resident in the production waveform/input buffer and the inference request is ready to begin.
primary_latency.end: The final H1 inference result required by the ordinary production reporting path is ready in firmware memory for reporting.
include_all_per_inference_work_after_sta: Cache clean/invalidate operations required by the run
Result conversion/postprocessing required by ordinary production reporting
exclude: Model hash verification performed only at initialization
Debug export/capture not part of ordinary production execution
primary_latency.one_time_exclusion_rule: Only work actually performed once at initialization is excluded. Model copies, checks or reconstruction performed per inference remain inside the interval and must satisfy the structural gates.
primary_latency.end_rule: Do not stop timing at the classifier IRQ or raw logits if ordinary reporting still requires conversion or postprocessing.

input.authority: Canonical valid 3-second waveform already used by the accepted uploaded-waveform route.

repeatability_campaign.warmup_policy: Five consecutive successful production-path runs immediately precede the measured sequence.
repeatability_campaign.measured_policy: One sequence of 100 consecutive completed production-path runs; retain every sample. Failed, incomplete or missing runs fail the campaign.

statistics_definition.count: 100 measured latency samples; warmups excluded from measured statistics.
statistics_definition.mean_ms: Arithmetic mean of all measured samples.
statistics_definition.median_ms: Mean of the 50th and 51st samples in ascending order.
statistics_definition.p95_ms: Nearest-rank percentile: ceil(0.95 * count), the 95th ascending sample for count 100.
statistics_definition.population_standard_deviation_ms: Square root of sum((sample - mean)^2) / count; denominator 100.

repeatability_campaign.raw_sample_retention: Preserve all 100 raw per-run latency samples privately with run identifiers, timestamp/cycle data and clock conversion identity.
repeatability_campaign.public_evidence: Compact aggregates plus bound identity/procedure information sufficient to reproduce or inspect the campaign; no raw captures or restricted payloads.

acceptance_timing_mode.instrumentation: Minimal; must not materially distort production timing or behavior.
allowed: Lightweight counters that do not materially alter production behavior
forbidden_inside_primary_interval: Complete tensor CRC sweeps not part of production
acceptance_timing_mode.clock_requirements: Bind clock frequency and timestamp conversion, resolution and wrap handling; compare unrounded latency to the strict threshold.

diagnostic_profiling_mode.campaign: Separate from the acceptance timing campaign.
diagnostic_profiling_mode.substitution_policy: V1 does not allow diagnostic latency to substitute for acceptance timing. Any exception requires independently demonstrated negligible overhead and an explicitly permitting prospectively versioned criteria revision.

required_diagnostic_stage_profile.missing_metric_policy: Record availability and reason for any unavailable or unreliable metric; preserve the required stage boundaries.
required_diagnostic_stage_profile.historical_timing_policy: Historical D512 timing is architectural background only and must not substitute for current H1 baseline measurements.

every_production_transfer_or_handoff_req: Whether producer and consumer can legally share the same physical buffer
Reason if a copy is mandatory
baseline_memory_transfer_ledger.additional_scope: Audit every full-size frontend intermediate tensor.
baseline_memory_transfer_ledger.candidate_rule: Create candidate zero-copy opportunities only after the baseline ledger is observed.
baseline_memory_transfer_ledger.ownership_proof: Bind hardware/runtime accessibility, cache ownership and live-buffer lifetime evidence for each legally shared buffer and every proposed removed copy.

structural_performance_requirements.requirement: No CPU fallback from either U85 stage.
Model identities remain fixed during the campaign.
No numerical boundary regression relative to the applicable qualified authority.
Every removed copy is replaced by an explicitly proven ownership/lifetime transition.

zero_copy_definition.meaning: One producer -> one physical boundary buffer -> one consumer, where the hardware/runtime contract permits it.
zero_copy_definition.excluded_claim: Unavoidable U85 weight/activation memory traffic is not called zero-copy.

steps: Frontend writes directly to backbone input where legal.
Backbone output consumed in place by GeM where legal.
GeM/bridge writes directly to classifier input where legal.
Classifier output processed in place where legal.
Replace unnecessary whole-cache operations with validated range-specific maintenance.
Remove production-path diagnostic copies/CRCs not required for ordinary inference.
Only if required, investigate U85 staging/fast-memory changes.
Only after simpler transfer changes, consider frontend fusion, GeM arithmetic optimization or postprocessing changes.
nonbinding_investigation_order.selection_rule: Observed baseline data decides which candidates proceed; this order does not predetermine results.

numerical_equivalence_guard.authority: Applicable qualified H1 numerical/runtime authority bound through the published master and accepted records; preserve its documented claim scope and tolerances.
numerical_equivalence_guard.prohibition: Speed alone does not justify arithmetic/model changes or relaxed numerical tolerances, exact identities, model contracts or safety checks.

future_success_disposition.name: H1_REPEATABLE_SUB700MS_PERFORMANCE_PASS
requires_all: Production acceptance timing mode is used.
Both U85 stages remain the production route.
campaign_identity_binding: Source commit and source bundle identity

scope_exclusions: Energy per inference unless separately measured
live_audio_sequence: Line-input/live-microphone qualification starts only after this performance target is accepted.

integrity.sha256_binding: SHA-256 of the exact criteria bytes is recorded in docs/PERFORMANCE.md and private stage receipts.
integrity.revision_policy: Any later change requires a new prospectively versioned criteria file and an explicit reason; never edit this frozen file after observing benchmark results.

initialization_stop.stop_after: Two signed commits, performance-branch push and GitHub Verified checks.
